Class PseudoClassState

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.css.cascade.PseudoClassState
public final class PseudoClassState extends Object
Represents the current pseudo-class state of an element.

This is used during selector matching to determine if pseudo-class selectors like :focus, :hover, :disabled match the element.

For positional pseudo-classes like :nth-child(even), the nthChild field stores the 1-based position (0 means position is not set).

Usage Context:

  • CSS Styling (during render): All pseudo-classes work via RenderContext.childStyle() which accepts position and state
  • TFX Effects (post-render): Only :focus is supported because it's tracked by FocusManager. Other pseudo-classes require state/position info that isn't preserved after rendering.

    • PseudoClassState

      public PseudoClassState(boolean focused, boolean hovered, boolean disabled, boolean active, boolean selected, boolean firstChild, boolean lastChild, int nthChild)
      Creates a pseudo-class state with the given flags.
      Parameters:
      focused - whether the element has keyboard focus
      hovered - whether the mouse is over the element
      disabled - whether the element is disabled
      active - whether the element is being activated
      selected - whether the element is selected
      firstChild - whether the element is the first child of its parent
      lastChild - whether the element is the last child of its parent
      nthChild - the 1-based child position, or 0 if not set

    • has

      public boolean has(String pseudoClass)
      Checks if the given pseudo-class is active.

      Supports simple pseudo-classes (focus, hover, etc.) and functional pseudo-classes like nth-child(even) and nth-child(odd).

      Parameters:
      pseudoClass - the pseudo-class name (without colon)
      Returns:
      true if the pseudo-class is active
